course_review/1.card_source: golfify (golfify.io/courses/the-falls-golf-club-o-fallon), fetched 2026-10-30; AllSquare (meters) agrees hole for hole; club site thefallsgolfclub.com does not resolve (fallsgolf.com is the club site), GolfLink 403, BlueGolf 405
course_notes: Card, pars (36-35 = 71) and routing are right on all 18 holes; the build used the right card (golfify) and the right set names.

OSM maps 67 tees but no Gold boxes on 2, 3, 9, 10, 11, 13, 15, 16, 18: the build invented Gold tees 19-48 yds behind the back OSM tee (lidar pads / walkbacks). On 11, 13, 15, 16 and 18 they sit on streets, house lots or the road; on 2, 3, 9, 10 they are in trees / beside cart paths (uncertain). The Gold yardages on the page are card numbers measured from places nobody tees off.
Blue is on OSM tee boxes within 7 yds of the card on 17 holes; hole 18 Blue is a walkback (18 yds off an OSM box).

Fix: rebuild with "scorecard": "course_data/library/the_falls_ofallon/card_review.json" and tees ["Blue", "White"] (both sets sit on mapped OSM boxes). Gold needs the Gold boxes mapped (an osm_supplement from better imagery); none were visible on NAIP 2022, so none was written.
